BG_ANGER.title: Anger
BG_ANGER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put this card on top of your draw pile.

BG_BARRICADE.description: [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your turn ([blue]20[/blue] at most).

BG_BATTLE_TRANCE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
You cannot draw additional cards this turn.

BG_BERSERK.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal {Magic:diff()} damage to any row.
BG_BLOOD_FOR_BLOOD.title: Blood for Blood
BG_BLOOD_FOR_BLOOD.description:
Costs {Magic:diff()} if you lost HP this combat.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

BG_BODY_SLAM.title: Body Slam
BG_BURNING_PACT.title: Burning Pact
BG_CARNAGE.title: Carnage

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
BG_CLEAVE.title: Cleave
BG_CLOTHESLINE.title: Clothesline

BG_COMBUST.description: Once per turn (at the end of your turn): deal {Magic:diff()} damage to any row.

BG_CORRUPTION.description:

BG_DARK_EMBRACE.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, draw 1 card.
BG_DEMON_FORM.title: Demon Form
BG_DEMON_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
BG_DISARM.title: Disarm
BG_DOUBLE_TAP.title: Double Tap
BG_DOUBLE_TAP.description: This turn, your next Attack is played twice.
BG_ENTRENCH.title: Entrench
BG_EVOLVE.title: Evolve
BG_EVOLVE.description: Whenever you draw [gold]Dazed[/gold], [gold]Burn[/gold], or [gold]Slimed[/gold], draw 1 card.
BG_EXHUME.title: Exhume
BG_EXHUME.description: Put a card from your exhaust pile into your hand.
BG_FEED.title: Feed
BG_FEED.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills the enemy, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
BG_FEEL_NO_PAIN.title: Feel No Pain
BG_FIEND_FIRE.title: Fiend Fire
BG_FIEND_FIRE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way.
BG_FIRE_BREATHING.title: Fire Breathing
BG_FIRE_BREATHING.description: Whenever you draw [gold]Dazed[/gold], [gold]Burn[/gold], [gold]Slimed[/gold], or a Curse, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to any row.
BG_FLAME_BARRIER.title: Flame Barrier
BG_FLAME_BARRIER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to each enemy that intends to attack you, for each hit of its attack.
BG_FLEX.title: Flex
BG_FLEX.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Lose it at the end of your turn.
BG_GHOSTLY_ARMOR.title: Ghostly Armor
BG_HAVOC.title: Havoc
BG_HAVOC.description: Draw a card and play it for free. [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it unless it's a Power.
BG_HEADBUTT.title: Headbutt
BG_HEADBUTT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put a card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
BG_HEAVY_BLADE.title: Heavy Blade
BG_HEAVY_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Each [gold]Strength[/gold] adds {Magic:diff()} damage to this card (instead of 1).
BG_IMMOLATE.title: Immolate
BG_IMMOLATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Put 2 [gold]Dazed[/gold] on top of your draw pile.
BG_IMPERVIOUS.title: Impervious
BG_INFLAME.title: Inflame
BG_IRON_WAVE.title: Iron Wave
BG_IRON_WAVE.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:Choose: deal 1 damage and gain 2 [gold]Block[/gold], or deal 2 damage and gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold].|Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].}
BG_JUGGERNAUT.title: Juggernaut
BG_JUGGERNAUT.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage to an enemy of your choice.
BG_LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
BG_METALLICIZE.title: Metallicize
BG_METALLICIZE.description: At the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
BG_OFFERING.title: Offering
BG_PERFECTED_STRIKE.title: Perfected Strike
BG_PERFECTED_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

BG_POMMEL_STRIKE.title: Pommel Strike
BG_POWER_THROUGH.title: Power Through
BG_POWER_THROUGH.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] to any player.
Put 1 [gold]Dazed[/gold] on top of your draw pile.
BG_RAGE.title: Rage
BG_RAGE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each Attack in your hand.
BG_RAMPAGE.title: Rampage
BG_RAMPAGE.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card.
|}Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your exhaust pile.
BG_RUPTURE.title: Rupture
BG_SECOND_WIND.title: Second Wind
BG_SECOND_WIND.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all non-Attack cards in your hand.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way.
BG_SEEING_RED.title: Seeing Red
BG_SENTINEL.title: Sentinel
BG_SENTINEL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] to any player.
If this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
BG_SEVER_SOUL.title: Sever Soul
BG_SEVER_SOUL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:1 or 2 cards|1 card} in your hand.
BG_SHOCKWAVE.title: Shockwave
BG_SHRUG_IT_OFF.title: Shrug It Off
BG_SPOT_WEAKNESS.title: Spot Weakness
BG_SPOT_WEAKNESS.description: If the die shows {Magic:diff()} or less, give {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] to any player.
BG_TRUE_GRIT.title: True Grit
BG_TRUE_GRIT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] to any player.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your hand.
BG_TWIN_STRIKE.title: Twin Strike
BG_UPPERCUT.title: Uppercut
BG_WARCRY.title: Warcry
BG_WARCRY.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Put a card from your hand on top of your draw pile.
BG_WHIRLWIND.title: Whirlwind
BG_WHIRLWIND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X{IfUpgraded:show:+1|} times.
BG_WILD_STRIKE.title: Wild Strike
BG_WILD_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put 1 [gold]Dazed[/gold] on top of your draw pile.
